title: Boots & Guitars w/ Private Yard & Parking
description:
Step right into Nashville vibes—where boots meet guitars. This custom-built 2BR, 1.5BA retreat features 2 queen beds, an open layout, and a screened porch with TV, fire table, and dining space. Enjoy a fenced yard with fire pit, grill & cornhole. Inside: Dolly & Taylor-inspired rooms, curated guitar décor, and a karaoke setup. Walkable Lockeland Springs, <2 miles to downtown, parking for 2.

The space
Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen with stocked cookware, seamlessly flowing into an open-concept living area designed for comfort and connection. Upstairs, you’ll find two inviting bedrooms with a shared tub/shower bathroom, while the downstairs half bath features stunning custom floral wallpaper for a stylish touch.

Step out to the screened porch—your own cozy retreat with a sofa, chairs, large TV, fire table, and dining space perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The fenced yard welcomes your fur baby and offers a grill, fire pit, and cornhole for outdoor fun.

Inside, creativity shines with artistic guitars, cowboy boot accents, and a blend of country charm and modern comfort. Turn up the fun with your own karaoke setup—perfect for a Bluebird Café-style night in. Whether it’s a girls’ getaway, creative retreat, or work/play escape, this space feels like home with a little Nashville magic.

Guest access
Guests have access to the full home as well as fenced yard and driveway.

Other things to note
* Off-street parking available for up to 2 vehicles.
* The yard is fully fenced and private for guest use.
* There are no stairs required to enter the home; however, stairs are required to access the bedrooms.
* The sofa converts into a comfortable sleeper bed.
* Firewood is not provided for the outdoor Solo Stove.
* The home includes both a standard coffee maker and an espresso machine. Ground coffee is provided, along with a small starter supply of espresso pods.
* The home is located behind the main house but has its own private entrance and yard. It is an entirely separate home.
*Smart TVs are provided for streaming with your personal accounts.
* Quiet hours begin at 9 PM out of respect for neighbors.
* Starter supplies are provided, but guests may need to purchase additional items for longer stays.
* The property is family-friendly, but bedrooms are located upstairs.
* Important Note: The home is 650 square feet and includes a screened-in porch. Maximum occupancy: 6 guests.Please be aware that there is only one shower in the property.  We encourage you to review the photos carefully before booking. Please ensure you are comfortable with accommodating 6 guests in a 650-square-foot space.  Thank you for your understanding!

We want guests to feel comfortable and fully prepared for their stay, so please feel free to reach out with any questions before booking.
